Method of Attack: Remotely crash the Event Log service on Windows devices within the same Windows domain by sending a malformed UNICODE_STRING object to the ElfrRegisterEventSourceW method exposed by the RPC-based EventLog Remoting Protocol
Impacted Systems: All versions of Windows from Windows 7 up to Windows 11
Domain controllers and all Windows computers in the same Windows domain
Attack Vector: Network connectivity to the target device with any valid credentials (even low privileges) and local crash of Event Log service
